Podcast host Danny Jones trades chairs for episode 2349 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Jones runs his own interview show, where he talks with fringe researchers, whistleblowers, and storytellers. Here the guest becomes the host's subject, and two working podcasters compare notes.

The two talk shop about building a show, finding guests, and chasing strange stories for a living. Jones shares tales from his own interviews, and Rogan tests them the way he tests any guest's claims. The episode has a peer-to-peer feel that regular Rogan episodes lack: less interview, more two men in the same trade swapping war stories.
